scope: thuexemayhanoi/global — existing published URLs in vi, en, de, fr, es, nl, zh, pt, ko, ja
priority: Extends owner-directive-20261028-seo-only (no new articles, Hubs or URLs; PR #118 stays unmerged; Auto Publisher stays paused).
owner_intent: Run SEO A–Z autonomously on existing URLs with the Matrix on GitHub as the single source of state, so work resumes from GitHub after any session ends.
order: Image SEO (batches of at most 100 images)
QA → merge → deploy → live verification → Matrix sync after every batch

per_url_fields: featured and content images, alt, bytes, format
word count, content quality, internal links
branch, commit SHA, PR, GitHub Actions, QA evidence

image_standard.bytes: 100–300 KB per image; under 100 KB accepted when sharp (never padded); over 300 KB re-encoded unless a technical reason is recorded in the Matrix
other: do not delete or replace good images just for uniform size

meta_standard.title: 60–70 characters when natural and within display width; zh/ko/ja by display width; never change a good title only to reach a length
meta_standard.description: about 140–160 characters when suitable; zh/ko/ja by display width

content_standard: Review pages under 1,000 words and expand to about 1,600–5,000 words where the topic and reliable information support it; no word target for contact, privacy, terms or pages that need no length.
resume: On 'tiếp tục': read the Matrix and checkpoint on GitHub, check branch/PR/CI/deploy, finish the IN_PROGRESS task or next_action, then take the highest-priority TODO; push the Matrix and a new checkpoint before stopping; never restart or redo DONE work.
forbidden: fabricated SEO metrics, images presented as real photos, sources or verification results
marking work done before live verification
bypassing QA, branch protection, URL freeze or business-data protection
asking the owner for routine decisions
owner_actions_last: Search Console, GA4, unverified business data and outside permissions go to OWNER_ACTIONS_LAST and never block the work.
reporting: Final summary only after all self-executable work is done; progress and checkpoints are pushed to GitHub during the work.
